• Our client is an international digital services organization operating across several European markets.
• As part of its continued transformation journey, the company is strengthening its Customer Service function to improve service quality, operational efficiency, and customer experience.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead and develop a Customer Service organization operating across multiple European countries.
• People management up to 50 employees.
• Ensure operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and service consistency across all support channels.
• Define, monitor, and optimize KPIs, reporting frameworks, and performance dashboards.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives and operational efficiency programs.
• Partner with Technology & Commercial teams to address root causes of customer issues.
• Coach managers, develop talent, and lead organizational change initiatives.

• min. 7 years of leadership experience within Customer Service, Customer Operations, Customer Experience, or similar environments.
• Proven success managing international and multicultural teams.
• Strong background in performance management, KPI governance, and operational transformation.
• Languages : Fluent in French and English.
• Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, analytical, and change management capabilities.

Our client is a well-established and respected organization active in the automotive sector. They offer a collaborative environment, professional training opportunities, modern working practices, and a strong focus on employee development and work-life balance.

Jobomschrijving

Key Responsibilities

• Manage and follow up on B2B collection files.
• Analyze outstanding debt cases and monitor recovery procedures.
• Contact customers via phone, email, and written correspondence regarding overdue payments.
• Send payment reminders and formal notices.
• Maintain and update administrative records and internal systems.
• Coordinate with external partners, legal representatives, bailiffs, and internal departments.
• Monitor accounting statuses and liaise with the finance team.
• Prepare tailored repayment proposals.
• Ensure proper follow-up of ongoing legal and collection procedures.
• Identify risks and suggest process improvements to management.

Profile We're Looking For

• 3  years experience in credit collection and credit control
• Medior level professional with a structured way of working.
• Comfortable working in a B2B environment.
• Interest in legal procedures and debt recovery processes.
• Strong administrative and organizational skills.
• Good communication skills and confidence when dealing with customers.
• Proactive attitude and willingness to learn.
• Good command of French; Dutch or English is a strong advantage.
• Comfortable using different IT systems and tools.

• Leading international consulting organization supporting large-scale business and digital transformation programs across multiple industries.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead workshops to gather, challenge, and translate business requirements into S2P solutions.
• Configure and implement Ivalua solutions aligned with client procurement and finance processes.
• Coordinate and align stakeholders across Procurement, Finance, and IT functions.
• Analyze procurement processes, spend data, and governance frameworks to identify improvement opportunities.
• Drive data migration, data quality, testing, and solution validation activities.
• Support change management and user adoption throughout transformation programs.

• Proven experience in Source-to-Pay transformation and procurement digitalization projects.
• Hands-on experience with Ivalua or another leading S2P platform (SAP Ariba, Coupa, Jaggaer, GEP etc.).
• Strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills.
• Fluent in English and French and/or Dutch.
• Technical mindset with knowledge of data analysis, SQL, or business systems integration.

Our client is an international company active worldwide in the Media industry.In order to support their development, we are currently looking for a new Business Controller.Locally, they count around 200 employees.Their Belgian offices are located in Diegem.

Jobomschrijving

Business Controller - Media sector - DiegemThe Business Controller will be part of the Finance team composed of 7 people and will support the company in taking its financial and strategic decisions.The roll will be oriented on Business Controlling and on Project Management.The main tasks of the function will consist in :

• Acting as a Finance Business Partner to the Sales & Marketing teams
• Being responsible for the sales & performance analyses
• Participating to the construction of the budgets and forecasts
• Being in charge of the variances analyzes between the actuals & budget
• Challenging the business on the financial impact of the launch of new products / ideas
• Being responsible for the maintain and optimization of financial processes
• Participating to several important projects with a financial prospective.

Business Controller - Media sector - DiegemThe ideal Business Controller will meet the following criteria :

• Master's degree in Finance / Business Administration / Business Engineering
• Min. 5 years of financial experience in Controlling 
• Fluency in Dutch and English 
• Very good Excel skills
• Willing to take on a broad role in a dynamic international company.

jobs.description:
Our client is a family business operating since many years in the FMCG non Food Sector.They are located in the Walloon Brabant region.

Jobomschrijving

As an Order To Cash German And English your responsibilities are:

• Process customer orders accurately and keep order information up to date
• Handle customer service queries in German and English, providing clear information on orders
• Follow orders through the order-to-cash process to support timely completion
• Liaise with sales, logistics and finance departments
• Coordinate order-related information with relevant internal contacts
• Check customer and order details to help maintain accurate records
• Resolve routine order issues and communicate updates to customers
• Maintain clear documentation of customer contacts and order actions
• Contribute to a reliable customer service process for the Retail business

A successful Order To Cash German And English should have:

• Ability to communicate clearly in German and English
• A first experience in customer service or order to cash roles is a big plus
• Experience in the retail or hard discount world is a plus (Aldi, Lidl, Kruidvat, Colruyt, ...)
• You are accurate, meticulous and can handle deadlines
• Excellent communication skills with clients, distributors, internal stakeholders, ...
• A team player

Our client is a european fintech operating in the financial services and payments sector. Its Brussels-based offices offer a dynamic, modern and easily accessible working environment within a rapidly evolving industry.

Jobomschrijving

• Act as the AML Compliance Officer and oversee the organisation's AML/CFT framework
• Supervise KYC, CDD, sanctions screening, PEP reviews and transaction monitoring activities
• Manage, coach and develop a team of 6 compliance professionals
• Review and validate complex investigations and escalate sensitive cases when required
• Maintain and enhance AML/CFT policies, procedures and internal controls
• Coordinate regulatory reporting, audits and compliance reviews
• Collaborate closely with legal, risk and operational teams to ensure regulatory compliance

• Unlimited right to work in Belgium is mandatory for this position : applications without a valid work permit will not be considered.
• Degree in Law, Finance, Compliance, Risk Management or a related field
• Minimum 7 years of experience in AML/CFT, compliance or financial crime within financial services, payments or fintech
• Fluent in English; proficiency in French and/or Dutch is considered an advantage
• Strong knowledge of Belgian and European AML regulations, KYC/CDD, sanctions and transaction monitoring
• Excellent analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills
• Proven experience leading and developing compliance teams

For a leading manufacturer in the machine building industry in the region, we are looking for a dedicated Senior Electrical Engineer.

In this key engineering role, you will act as the technical owner for the complete electrical hardware design, ensuring every machine meets the highest quality and safety standards!

As Senior Electrical Engineer, you will take full ownership of the electrical engineering lifecycle:

• Concept & Project Planning: Participate in multidisciplinary project design meetings with mechanical and software engineers from the concept phase onwards, creating realistic project schedules and milestones.
• Electrical Design (EPLAN P8 & ProPanel): Translate draft electrical descriptions and specifications into clear, detailed hardware guidelines. Design and adapt electrical schematics in EPLAN P8 and create 3D panel/enclosure layouts in EPLAN ProPanel.
• Standards & Compliance: Ensure all designs strictly comply with European directives and international regulations (e.g., EN 60204, Machinery Directive, EMC, LVD).
• ERP & Production Follow-Up: Create and update ERP work orders for customer-specific projects and master BOMs for standard machinery. Closely monitor electrical assembly during the build phase in the workshop.
• Standardization & Mentorship: Develop, maintain, and continuously improve electrical design guidelines and best practices. Review schematics with colleagues, offer technical guidance, and actively drive departmental standardization initiatives.Profiel
• Education & Experience: You hold a Master’s degree in Industrial Sciences (Electromechanics / Electrotechnics) or possess equivalent experience. You have at least 5 years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably within the machine building sector.
• Software & Standards: Strong proficiency in EPLAN P8 is required (hands-on experience with EPLAN ProPanel is a major plus). Solid working knowledge of European electrical safety standards (familiarity with UL standards for the North American market is an asset).
• Key Strengths: You possess an analytical mindset, excellent problem-solving skills, and a structured way of working.
• Languages & Communication: Excellent communication skills in both English and Dutch, with a collaborative team spirit suited for an international environment.Wat je van ons krijgt
• Company Mobility: A representative company car with fuel card (also available for personal use).
• Attractive Salary Package: A highly competitive gross monthly salary tailored to your seniority and technical expertise, complemented by an extensive benefits package (meal vouchers, group insurance, healthcare coverage, and net allowances). 
• Impact & Ownership: A technical role offering high autonomy, allowing you to directly shape product designs and drive standardization.
• International Environment: A challenging, collaborative, and growth-oriented working culture with ample opportunities for professional development.

As a RENOVATION WORKER in MIDDELKERKE, you recognize yourself in the following:

For our client in the VEURNE region, we are looking for a motivated GROUNDWORKER.

Our client is a highly driven company with 125 years of experience, specialized in earthworks and the installation of pipelines and landscaping for cities and municipalities.

As a CONSTRUCTION WORKER in the VEURNE region, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

• Sewer installation works
• Installing curbstones and edging
• Construction of cycle paths, roads, and parking areas
• Laying environmental pavement solutions
• Installation of roundabouts and traffic islands
• Laying paving stones and sidewalk tiles
• Small to large-scale earthworks
 

As a GROUNDWORKER in the VEURNE region, you can identify yourself in the following profile:

• You speak Dutch, English, or French fluently;
• You have relevant experience in road construction;
• You hold a valid driving licence B (additional licences are a plus);
• You are able to travel to the company independently (not accessible by public transport);
• You are practical, hands-on, and enjoy working outdoors.
